user.title: Add Raylogic MOD2U / MOD4U / MOD2F
user.description: Raylogic modules network par khud announce nahi karte - HA se LAN scan karwao (recommended) ya IP address khud daalo.

menu_options.scan: Scan network for Raylogic MOD modules

scan.title: Scan network
scan.description: Neeche diye subnet(s) ke har host ko port 5550 par check kiya jaayega (~10 s). Jo devices pehle se HA me add hain (raylogic_mod ya raylogic) unhe chhua nahi jaata. Modules kisi aur subnet par hon to hi list badlo (comma-separated CIDR, e.g. 192.168.120.0/24).

pick.title: Raylogic modules found
pick.description: {count} module(s) ne jawab diya. Ek chuno - agla form uske detected Model/Area/First Channel se pre-filled khulega (check karke confirm karo). Agle module ke liye Add Integration dobara chalao.

manual.title: Add Raylogic MOD2U / MOD4U / MOD2F
manual.description: Device ka IP address daalo, aur Device Model chuno - MOD2U (2 channel, 1 pair), MOD4U (4 channel, 2 pairs), ya MOD2F (single-channel, fixed Fan type). Agla step aapke chune hue model ke hisaab se sirf utne hi channel fields dikhayega (MOD2F ke liye koi Type dropdown nahi dikhega - wo hamesha Fan hi hota hai, sirf Area aur channel number daalna hai).

channels.title: Configure channels
channels.description: Area wahi daalo jo Mod Settings screen mein dikhta hai (e.g. 12 ya 16). Area = 0 sirf tab chalega jab sabhi channel 'relay' hon (HA khud seekh lega app/switch se ek baar toggle karke) - Dimmer/Fan/Curtain/CTC ke liye Area zaroor manually dena hoga. Channels 2 PAIRS mein hote hain: Pair 1 = Channel 1(+2), Pair 2 = Channel 3(+4) (MOD2U par sirf Pair 1 exist karta hai). CTC (colour-temperature light) aur Curtain DONO apni pair ke dono physical channels internally use karte hain - agar Channel 1 Type = 'ctc' ya 'curtain' chuno to Channel 2 Type field automatically ignore ho jaata hai (ek hi entity banti hai), aur waisa hi Channel 3/4 ke liye. CTC choose karne par uska Driver Mode bhi batao - 'single' (app mein 'Single Driver' checked) ya 'double'.

data.channel_start: First Channel Number (usually 1, but check Raylogic GO app if channels don't start at 1)
data.channel_1_ctc_mode: Channel 1 CTC Driver Mode (only if Channel 1 Type = ctc)
data.channel_2_ctc_mode: Channel 2 CTC Driver Mode (only if Channel 2 Type = ctc)
data.channel_3_ctc_mode: Channel 3 CTC Driver Mode (only if Channel 3 Type = ctc)
data.channel_4_ctc_mode: Channel 4 CTC Driver Mode (only if Channel 4 Type = ctc)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to device. Check IP address and ensure device is powered on.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check logs for details.
error.area_required_for_non_relay: Dimmer/Fan/Curtain/CTC channels ke liye Area (0 nahi) manually dena zaroori hai - auto-learn sirf Relay ke liye kaam karta hai.
error.bad_subnet: Ek ya zyada valid IPv4 subnet CIDR form me daalo, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24 (max /22).
error.no_devices_found: Port 5550 par koi naya Raylogic module nahi mila. Check karo ki wo on hai aur isi network par hai (pehle se add kiye hue list nahi hote).
error.host_in_other_integration: Ye IP pehle se 'raylogic' (main/DIN) integration me add hai. Ek hi module ko dono integrations me add mat karo - ek device par do TCP connections conflict karte hain.

abort.already_configured: This Raylogic device is already configured.

init.title: Configure Raylogic device
init.description: Channel type (relay/dimmer/fan/curtain/ctc), Area, ya channel numbering yahan se badlo - device delete karne ki zaroorat nahi. Device Model yahan se badla nahi ja sakta - model change karna ho to device delete karke naya add karo. Yaad rakho: Pair 1 = Channel 1(+2), Pair 2 = Channel 3(+4) - Curtain/CTC ek pair ka dono channel consume karte hain. Area scenes: Raylogic GO app ke area scenes 'area:scene,scene; area:scene' format me (e.g. '12:1,2,3; 5:1,4') - kisi bhi EK device par daalna kaafi hai, har area ke liye scene entities + ek scene dropdown banega. Khaali = koi scene nahi.

error.area_required_for_non_relay: Dimmer/Fan/Curtain/CTC ke liye Area manually dena zaroori hai (0 sirf Relay LEARN mode ke liye chalta hai).
error.bad_scene_map: Area scenes samajh nahi aaye - format 'area:scene,scene; area:scene' hai (area 1-16, scene 1-64), e.g. '12:1,2,3; 5:1,4'.
error.host_in_other_integration: Ye IP pehle se 'raylogic' (main/DIN) integration me add hai - MOD entry ko us module par point nahi kar sakte (ek device par do TCP connections conflict karte hain).

recall_scene.name: Recall area scene
recall_scene.description: Recall a Raylogic GO app area scene through every connected MOD module.
